items.title: Matcha + Meetup: DTLA (Giving Back Edition)
items.pay: ticket via Eventbrite; drinks bought at the cafe
items.description: A small friendship meetup of 4 to 6 strangers over coffee or matcha at a local cafe, with proceeds supporting The Comeunity Project. The cafe is different each time and shared with attendees by email.
items.notes: Meetup, not a matcha pop-up (kind class/meetup in spirit): venue is a rotating placeholder, so not promotable. Listing shows only a generic 'Multiple dates' plus this Nov 29 12 PM slot; no street address.
